question: How does the source connect its nitrogenous-state EPR progress curve with Janus-state formation during frozen-solid relaxation, without treating signal amplitude or distributed decay as an elementary rate?
identity_scope: The same primary paper names WT A. vinelandii MoFe protein and assigns the E4(4H) state. The prior isotope study supplies state-assignment context only; it does not supply cryoannealing conditions, a shared physical specimen or exact assayed sequence.

source_model.scope: One source-assigned state coupling selected from P34-P35; neither the complete Figure9 sequential scheme nor its unseen graphical arrows are reconstructed.

states.scope: Source diazene-reduction-level shorthand with unknown structure and coordination geometry.
Source-assigned two bridging hydrides; exact metal pairs and protonated sulfur sites remain unspecified.

transitions.source_name: Source-interpreted oxidative-addition direction of the re/oa coupling
transitions.reversibility_scope: The paper interprets kinetic reversibility of the re/oa activation equilibrium; this selected cryoannealing record does not measure both directional rates or both directional fluxes.

forward.reason: The selected relation binds qualitative EPR time-course evidence. The caption reports distributed decay fitting, not an elementary directional rate; no graphical tau-to-arrow mapping is projected.

reverse.reason: The selected relation binds qualitative EPR time-course evidence. The caption reports distributed decay fitting, not an elementary directional rate; no graphical tau-to-arrow mapping is projected.

deposit_absence_reason: No atom-resolved arrangement, PDB/sequence correspondence, exact Fe/S sites or M0212 scheme identity is established for these experimentally assigned states. E4(2N2H) structure and coordination remain unknown.
limitations: Two qualitative, state-specific views of one source cryoannealing experiment; not two independent experiments, raw curves, direct elementary events or new laboratory observations by the project.
Observed EPR signal amplitudes remain distinct from source-assigned state identity and P35 interpretation of coupled loss/formation. Net rise of the Janus trace is unestablished.

The source scales E4 concentrations with the sequential model, so concentration trends and fitted populations are not independent validation of that model. Other EPR-detected and EPR-silent populations are not projected as a closed two-state system.
The selected edge has onward relaxation through E2 to E0 in the source description. No mass balance, direct H2 uptake/N2 release or complete pathway is inferred from the selected edge.

The retained Figure9 caption and text are inspected; Figure9 and Chart3 images, raw data, original fitting implementation and cited previous protocols remain uninspected. No fit parameters, per-arrow time constants or elementary rates are assigned.
Source review and applicability remain manual. Computational reviewers are correlated; this relation is not independent human review, a new evidence tier or design validation.
